notes.title: Act 2 BIG Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32647957/38b067c7a1b90a71dc6360fe88d4c30a7b9370ca.png[/img]

We've had a ton of fun working on Dungeon Brewmaster and aim to deliver big content while in Early Access. The first large piece of that is live now with the addition of Act 2 while Act 3 is currently in the works along with another super cool unannounced update!    

[h1] Story Mode Act 2 "What Did You Do?!" [/h1]
First day on the job can be tough…especially when you Brew up a magical sword for the murder hungry Buffula Kimberly. Although her actions SEEM like your fault…they totally are. Maybe you can right the wrongs and stop war from entering Harbor Dues Dungeon Tavern? Or perhaps you want a little war to liven the place up! Big choices will be made in Act 2 defining you as a true Brewmaster! This first story addition will feature brand new characters, bizarre new brews and of course a bunch of Goblins ordering new “gourmet” menu items. Act 2 will lead into our next big update…yep you guessed it…Act 4 (Joyce does all of our math)
  [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32647957/907cbdcd1cd427a561a80c3465409666f611d20d.png[/img]

[h1] Characters & Brews Added to Free Play [/h1]
Free Play needed some love and it is getting it! Certain Story characters are now Tavern regulars as well as some Free Play exclusive additions. Unlike the Goblins these patrons will be ordering Brews so dust off that Cauldron! Just like the characters, certain Story Brews have made their way into Free Play as well as some exclusives. This is an area we will be adding to greatly to as we progress. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32647957/d027ff027f76948ded65cf95ae1a872b37017528.png[/img]

[h1] 6 New Characters [/h1]
The great and lazy Frogre Kingdom has deployed its ranks to help prevent this potential war from starting…and they are looking to YOU to serve them up some Brews to help their cause. Opposing them is the overly aggressive Buffula Clan whose General is looking to finish the job Kimberly started…with a little Brew help. New characters from each race are in town looking to visit your Tavern however what you serve them may decide friend or foe.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32647957/e795e738eaf3412646a16b6114c136f919c67add.png[/img]

[h1] 7 New Brews [/h1]
Being a Brewmaster means always keeping up on trends and adding to your Brew list! Act 2 brings in new, bizarre Brews each with their own effect. Being a Brewmaster also means being your own boss…if a grumpy patron comes in looking for a Bulking Brew why not instead whip him up a nice PukeBeer Throat Brew :) 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32647957/900251a36afc5938a79952341e53f1e429b4619c.png[/img]

[h1] Settings Menu [/h1]
Before you select Story or Free Play pressing the menu - A/B button will bring up the settings menu in the Recipe Book. Here you are now able to change Quality, Player Size and turning on / off Post FX. Player size ranges from Goblin sized to Frogre.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32647957/6161e2297694f3633fd48bcc9f027065ac48cbfd.png[/img]

[h1] Tons of New Alchemy Combinations [/h1]
We are still working on some big systems for item creation as there is a lot we would like to do here! For Act 2 we have added a bunch of great new combinations all around including a way to combine multiple materials together (Gold + Crystal + Evil Whispers Vial…) Many combinations that used to make a lovely poop now have a combined result. Don’t worry though we’ve also added more things you create using…poop. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32647957/26b6282cbb50b4bc67474825a1d81d273d928d21.png[/img]

[h1] Other Updates [/h1]
Ms Goblin Merchant formally known as Horatio, Mr. Deals, Steven and more now has some hot new items for sale. We are constantly changing / improving hand interaction which is live with this update and likely more on the way. We've changed the hanging shelves to hold ingredients better since Mark the Cyclops Head enjoyed backflipping off. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32647957/6234c3495c68d694a8d4fea1997daa1789d07ad3.png[/img]
